name: API Layer
description: FastAPI route handlers for auth, gallery CRUD, and photo lifecycle operations — the HTTP interface exposed to the Angular frontend.

name: Service Layer
description: Cross-cutting backend services (JWT security, Pillow imaging, ORM serialization, FastAPI DI) and Angular client services that mediate between UI components and the REST API.

name: Data Layer
description: SQLAlchemy ORM models, database session factory, Pydantic request/response schemas, and Alembic migration scripts that define and evolve the PostgreSQL schema.

name: UI & Presentation Layer
description: Angular components, directives, and styles that render the public photography showcase (landing masonry, gallery pages, lightbox) and the admin panel for content management.

name: Bootstrap & Configuration
description: Application entry points and wiring files that assemble the FastAPI app and Angular SPA — including CORS setup, router mounting, route tables, DI providers, and runtime config injection.

name: Infrastructure
description: Docker images for the FastAPI backend and Angular/nginx frontend, docker-compose orchestration of the 3-service stack, nginx SPA serving config, and container startup scripts.

name: Build & Project Config
description: Build toolchain configuration for both the Angular CLI workspace and Python backend — TypeScript compiler options, npm manifest, Angular schematics, Alembic INI, environment templates, and runtime asset config.

name: Documentation
description: Project-level documentation and tooling metadata, including the comprehensive README covering architecture and API reference, and the Understand-Anything scanner ignore rules.
